description: This file defines the 'ResetPasswordRequest' entity class for a Human Resource Management System, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to database table columns related to password reset requests.

classes.name: ResetPasswordRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a password reset request with fields for email, request date, reset code, and expiration status, mapped to the 'ohrm_reset_password' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reset password request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the reset password request.

methods.name: getResetEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address associated with the reset request.

methods.name: setResetEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address for the reset request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the reset request was made.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time of the reset request.

methods.name: getResetCode
methods.description: Returns the reset code associated with the request.

methods.name: setResetCode
methods.description: Sets the reset code for the reset request.

methods.name: getExpired
methods.description: Returns whether the reset request has expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Sets the expiration status of the reset request.
